Time Capsule Maker

Seal a message in a digital time capsule — it stays locked with a live countdown until its opening date arrives.

Your capsules

📖 How to use

  1. Write your message to the future.
  2. Pick the date the capsule should open.
  3. Press Seal capsule — a live countdown starts.
  4. Come back on the date to read your message.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where are capsules stored?

In this browser's localStorage, sealed until the opening date. They don't sync to other devices.

What happens when the date arrives?

On or after the opening date the capsule unlocks and the message is revealed automatically.

Can I delete a sealed capsule?

Deleting a sealed capsule is permanent — the message is gone. Only delete if you're sure.
